name: Backups watch
description: The last run, size and failures of your Backrest or Kopia backups on a card, and an alert when one is overdue.
author: TheMightyTRexUK

settings.label: Backup tool
settings.hint: Backrest or Kopia. Duplicati is not offered yet: its server API could not be checked from its documentation.

settings.label: Its address
settings.hint: Such as http://192.0.2.10:9898 for Backrest, or https://192.0.2.10:51515 for the Kopia server.

settings.label: User name
settings.hint: Leave empty if the tool needs no sign-in. For Kopia, the server's user name.

settings.label: Password
settings.hint: The tool's password. Starboard never shows it again.

settings.label: Accept a self-signed certificate
settings.hint: For a Kopia server that makes its own certificate. Only on your own network.

settings.label: Overdue after
settings.hint: How many hours without a good run count as overdue. 36 suits a nightly backup.

settings.label: Send alerts through Starboard
settings.hint: Sends one alert when a backup is overdue or failed, and one when it is fine again, to where Starboard sends its own alerts.

example.text: All 3 backed up. Last run 6 hours ago.

items.title: documents

example.note: Data added by each run the plug-in has kept. A gap is a failed run.

changed: Plainer wording in the text and help pages. How it works has not changed.

added: **One card for your backups:** the last run, the size and the failures of each Backrest plan or Kopia source.
**Alerts:** once when a backup is overdue or its last run failed, and once when it is fine again, through Starboard.
**You choose** the tool, its address and password, and how many hours count as overdue.
**Light:** it wakes once an hour, asks the tool once and rests; its cards read what it kept.
